user.title: RGBroadcast
user.description: Simulate a television for occupancy while you are away. The screen light does the full brightness swing; spill lights are optional ambient bounce that stay dimmer and follow the screen.

data_description.screen_light: The main light, driven with the full television effect.
data_description.spill_lights: Extra lights lit as if by the screen: dimmer, and following the screen's colour with a lag.

error.light_not_found: That light could not be found. Pick a light that currently exists.
error.light_onoff_only: That light can only switch on and off, so there is nothing to vary. Pick a dimmable or colour light.

abort.already_configured: Those lights are already set up as a RGBroadcast.

init.title: RGBroadcast settings
init.description: Style, intensity and ad breaks are controlled by their own entities, so you can change them live from a dashboard. These settings apply to how the lights are driven.

data_description.brightness_ceiling: Scales every style's brightness down, for a dim room.
data_description.force_steps: Turn on if your light claims to support transitions but visibly snaps instead. Common on Matter lights.
data_description.disable_cct: Forces colour output instead of white-balance changes on capable lights.
data_description.force_tier: Only needed if a light misreports what it can do. Leave on Auto otherwise.
data_description.tick_min: Leave blank to pick automatically from the light's capability.
data_description.tick_max: Leave blank to pick automatically from the light's capability.

onoff_light.title: A RGBroadcast light can no longer be simulated
onoff_light.description: The light {entity} now reports that it can only switch on and off, so the RGBroadcast simulation for {name} cannot vary it. Check the light, or reconfigure the RGBroadcast to use a dimmable or colour light.
